integrity: The proof is self-contained beyond the identified source model and uses an analytical upper/lower Hausdorff argument. Attached code checks finite branch arithmetic only; it does not certify infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-branch degree-one lifts and fixed sign environments with limiting frequency 0<p<1 only; no result for arbitrary random maps, without frequency limits, packing dimensions or Hausdorff measures. No independent validation or exhaustive novelty proof.
title: Quenched Hausdorff spectra of regular and historic rotation in a three-branch random circle map
